name: Zwei Brüder - Pizza & Kebab
kurzbeschreibung:
**Two Brothers – Pizza & Kebab in Kufstein**

Authentic Flavors from the Heart of Tirol

Welcome to **Two Brothers**, where the passion for Italian and Turkish cuisine meets the charm of **Kufstein**. Our cozy restaurant invites you to savor delicious **Pizza**, fresh **Kebab**, and other mouthwatering dishes in a warm, family-friendly atmosphere.

Our Specialties

  • Pizza – Wood-fired, crispy, and full of flavor, baked in our traditional stone oven.
  • Kebab – Tender, juicy, and perfectly seasoned, just like in the best Turkish taverns.
  • Kaiserschmarrn – A sweet, fluffy Austrian classic, best enjoyed with fresh fruit or a dusting of powdered sugar.
  • Fresh Salads & Dips – Light, healthy, and bursting with Mediterranean flavors.
  • Beer & Wine – A fine selection of local **Tiroler** beers and fine wines to complement your meal.

Visit Us in Kufstein

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, **Two Brothers** is the perfect stop for families, friends, and food lovers. Whether you're exploring the scenic beauty of **Tirol** or simply craving a hearty meal, we’re here to welcome you with open arms.

Come taste the fusion of tradition and innovation—where every bite tells a story.

Your Two Brothers Team
